# netactuate_server_nics (Data Source)

Reads Server Nics visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_server_nics" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID whose network interfaces will be listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nics` (List of Object) List of extra server network interfaces. The element shape is intentionally empty because no server on the test account had an extra NIC when this data source was added. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nics))
